verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack addresses whether Appwrite uses customer data to train AI models, and no documented opt-out or no-training policy appears. Self-hosting with "full control over data location" and SOC-2/HIPAA compliance are adjacent privacy controls, not a training-data guarantee, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
